info.title: Nutanix Security APIs
info.description: Manage security features, such as encryption, certificates, or platform hardening.

tags.name: SecurityConfigsVisibility
tags.description: The security visibility configurations control which security hardening settings are displayed on the Prism Central security dashboard UI.  These APIs allow administrators to customize the visibility of security configurations on the dashboard.

tags.name: Vulnerabilities
tags.description: Provides an ability to view vulnerabilities affected in the system based on NXVD (Nutanix Vulnerabilities Database). Vulnerabilities can be listed for a clusters and different products in a clusters.

tags.name: STIGs
tags.description: The Security Technical Implementation Guide (STIG) is a configuration standard consisting of cybersecurity requirements for a specific product. STIGs usage provides a methodology for securing protocols within networks, servers, computers, and logical designs to improve overall security. The STIG APIs provide the ability to view the STIG report and details about the STIGs in a cluster.

tags.name: ApprovalPolicies
tags.description: The approval policies define the approval flow for the Secure Snap feature in the system. The approval policies APIs allow users to manage approval policies in the system. It can be created, updated, deleted, and listed.

tags.name: SecuritySummaries
tags.description: Provides an ability to view summaries of different security entities in the system. Summaries like vulnerabilities, hardenings, stigs. Also user can trigger scan to generate reports and run Vulnerabilities, STIGs scan on the clusters.

tags.name: SecurityProfiles
tags.description: Security Profiles are set of profiles that can be applied to the cluster to enforce set of security configs mapped to the respective profile. This API will phase out the existing security configs API which are used to manage individual security configurations. Once a profile is applied, advanced-config API will be used to manage individual security configs like banner, userspace core and kernelspacecore.

tags.name: Credentials
tags.description: Provides the ability Create credentials and manage them.

tags.name: KeyManagementServers
tags.description: Key Management Servers secure data encryption keys when encryption is enabled.

parameters.name: $filter
parameters.description:
A URL query parameter that allows clients to filter a collection of resources. The expression specified with $filter is evaluated for each resource in the collection, and only items where the expression evaluates to true are included in the response. Expression specified with the $filter must conform to the [OData V4.01](https://docs.oasis-open.org/odata/odata/v4.01/odata-v4.01-part1-protocol.html) URL conventions.
For example, filter **$filter=name eq 'karbon-ntnx-1.0'** would filter the result on cluster name 'karbon-ntnx1.0', filter **$filter=startswith(name, 'C')** would filter on cluster name starting with 'C'. If both $filter and $apply query parameters are present, $filter will be applied on entities within the groups.

parameters.name: $orderby
parameters.description: A URL query parameter that allows clients to specify the sort criteria for the returned list of objects. Resources can be sorted in ascending order using asc or descending order using desc. If asc or desc are not specified, the resources will be sorted in ascending order by default. For example, '$orderby=templateName desc' would get all templates sorted by templateName in descending order. If both $orderby and $apply query parameters are present, $orderby will be applied on entities within the groups.

parameters.name: $select
